title: Size bound for the sealed circuit
statement: Let $C$ be a finite Boolean circuit with $n$ input vertices, gates in topological order, and a designated output vertex. The size of its sealed circuit is at most four times the size of $C$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a DAG circuit with $n$ inputs, gates in topological order, and a valid designated output
